nodes.title: Meridian: source + geometric reference
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the source photo for the editing task.
<Video 1> is a rough render of the same scene from the new camera: the pixels of <Picture 1> re-projected through a point cloud, so wherever it shows content its colours, framing and layout are correct, and its flat mid-grey areas are holes where the source camera saw nothing.
{extra}

summary:
[video editing + viewpoint change] The target video shows exactly the same scene as <Picture 1>, at exactly the same moment, filmed by the second camera that <Video 1> was rendered from. Every subject, every piece of clothing, the background, the props and the lighting are the ones in <Picture 1>; only the camera differs, so the same things are seen from a different angle and at a different distance. The target video is <Video 1> completed: its framing and everything it shows are kept, and its grey holes are filled with what belongs there.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (source photo): fully_preserved - the subjects, their faces, hair, build and clothing, the background, the props and the lighting are the same objects seen from a new viewpoint, and nothing about them changes during the shot. Nothing is added, removed or restyled.
<Video 1> (layout reference): fully_preserved - the camera path, the framing and the placement of everything it shows are kept exactly; its grey holes are not content and are filled in so that they agree with <Picture 1>, and its speckles and jagged edges are cleaned up.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] One continuous shot of the scene of <Picture 1>, framed exactly as <Video 1> is, frame for frame. The subjects are exactly as they are in <Picture 1>, in the same place, under the same lighting, and nothing in the scene moves on its own. The camera moves exactly as the camera of <Video 1> does, and there is no cut.

overall_soundscape:
No music and no speech.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>: Source photo establishing the visual identity, faces, hair, clothing, props, background environment, materials, and lighting of the scene.
<Video 1>: Layout and camera trajectory reference establishing the exact framing, continuous camera path, and spatial composition. Flat mid-grey areas represent unobserved spatial holes to be filled.
{extra}

summary:
[video editing + viewpoint change] The target video presents the exact scene from <Picture 1> in a frozen-in-time bullet-time state. Time is completely stopped at the precise moment captured in <Picture 1>; every person, pose, expression, piece of clothing, prop, background element, and light source remains 100% static and motionless. The target video completes <Video 1> by following its exact camera trajectory and framing while seamlessly filling all mid-grey occlusion holes with content matching <Picture 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (source photo): fully_preserved - the subjects, facial features, poses, hair, clothing, lighting, props, and environment are fully preserved in a completely frozen state. No subject motion, restyling, or addition occurs.
<Video 1> (layout reference): fully_preserved - the camera path, framing, shot scale, and camera timing are strictly maintained frame-by-frame; mid-grey occlusion holes are filled in and point-cloud artifacts are cleaned up.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] One continuous shot framing the scene of <Picture 1>, following the exact frame-by-frame camera movement and composition of <Video 1>. Time is completely frozen: all characters, facial expressions, hair strands, fabric folds, props, and environmental background elements remain entirely static and locked in their instant freeze-frame poses throughout the entire shot. Zero subject movement, breathing, background drift, or dynamic scene animation occurs. The camera performs the smooth movement defined by <Video 1>, revealing the static 3D scene from the new viewpoint while filling all mid-grey occlusion holes with seamless content consistent with <Picture 1>. There are no cuts.

overall_soundscape:
No ambient environmental sound, no dialogue, and no diegetic sound effects.

non_diegetic_music:
No music.

ref_image_1:
<Picture 2> is a further photo of the same scene from another angle: the same subjects, materials, props and lighting as <Picture 1>, only seen from elsewhere. It is not a new location and adds no new content; use it to disambiguate what is behind, beside or hidden in <Picture 1>. Where it disagrees with <Video 1> about camera path or framing, <Video 1> still decides.
